mapper.select: SELECT prod_cd AS product_code, -- 상품코드 prod_nm AS product_name, -- 상품명 -- 상품구분. 1=DEPOSIT, 2=LOAN, 나머지 UNKNOWN CASE upper(btrim(prod_dv_cd)) WHEN '1' THEN 'DEPOSIT' WHEN '2' THEN 'LOAN' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS product_type, COALESCE(upper(btrim(sale_yn)) = 'Y', FALSE) AS on_sale, -- sale_yn이 Y일 때만 true CASE WHEN reg_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' END AS registered_at, 'LEGACY_PROD' AS source_system, 'PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT' AS event_type, to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' AS extracted_at FROM src_prod ORDER BY prod_cd
